testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a sketch line weight change: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:498:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a sketch line weight change ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a nested sketch in the MCAD Software has Default line weight ✔ When the user opens Properties from the sketch row context menu ✔ And the user opens the Line Weight list ✔ Then the list shows Default and numeric millimeter weights with line samples ✔ And 0.25 mm is available ✔ When the user chooses 0.25 mm ✔ Then the Line Weight field displays 0.25 mm and Apply is enabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel and reopens the sketch properties ✔ Then the Line Weight field displays Default and Apply is disabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the properties dialog closes
